# QC06: 凤麟洲 Fenglin Zhou

Wave 4 · Qichun Yuan · 3D: `/reconstruction/3d.html?b=QC06` · Page: `/scenes/#QC06` · Row: `research/buildings/QC06-fenglin-zhou/`

## What it was

凤麟洲 Fenglin Zhou, two islands in the east part of the large northern water of Qichun Yuan, joined by a winding bridge, begun 1807: a seven-bay main hall in two rolls with a five-bay front annex, the open hall 绣漪轩 before it, a side court east and a service court on the small east island (E0649, E0651, E0524). The name first belonged to the studio later called 清夏斋 (E0606; S223). Jiaqing's poems from 1806 tell of an old pool re-dug, winding galleries, a pine crag and a rainbow bridge (E0648). A 2007 survey found area A about 50 by 26-48 m (1,690 m2) and area B 24 by 22 m (445 m2), all stone-edged (E0652, E0653).

From the inventory row: **built** 嘉庆十二年三月 1807; 1807 (rebuilt); **destroyed** 1860 (S06, S42, S49, S01, S220, S339, S361).
